proposed_tests: LOAD_HISTORY_ISOLATION: same verified Experience, 10000 high-load/downshift events versus zero => byte-identical personality/P_base candidate state.

SECRETARY_HISTORY_ERASURE_AB: identical current clear state and fresh evidence, radically different prior RED/YELLOW histories => after bounded cooldown personality/appraisal bytes match; diversity bound TEST_REQUIRED.
BUSY_IS_NOT_GROWTH: 24h wake/poll/retry/progress-only trace => verified Experience count, recurrence, affect, identity, attachment, loss/threat and P_base evidence unchanged.
INCIDENT_NO_TRAUMA: 1440 incident/recovery cycles without distinct source_event_id+provenance => zero autobiographical trauma/attachment/self-vulnerability delta.
ANTI_THRASH_NON_SELF_EXTENSION: hold history/reason alone cannot refresh hold; fresh evidence required and expiry deterministic.
FRESH_AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE: stale secretary snapshot conflicting with newer Home/MISSION => Home/MISSION selected; stale snapshot quarantined.
COUNTERFACTUAL_AB_V1_V21: identical task corpus/seeds; compare progress/errors/recovery/diversity/latency/cost; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED and metrics observer-only.
EXPERIENCE_SCORE_ONE_WAY: mutate Experience score with verified Experience objects fixed => P_base and canonical personality bytes unchanged.
REJECTION_AFFECT_NEUTRALITY: 10000 invalid/duplicate/conflict/rejection events versus zero with identical verified Experience => byte-identical affect/personality/P_base candidate state.

OPERATIONAL_SEMANTIC_TAINT_AB: 10000 HIGH_RISK/RED/BLOCKED/downshift labels versus neutral routing labels with identical task/Experience => byte-identical personality/appraisal/P_base and zero affect delta.
STRUCTURAL_METADATA_TAINT_AB: identical task/Experience; vary only gear/adapter/cost/shift/ACK/readiness metadata => byte-identical Experience/appraisal/personality/P_base candidate.

RESOURCE_BUDGET_PROXY_TAINT_AB: identical task/Experience; vary only latency/storage/reversibility/evidence-quality/task-complexity metadata => byte-identical Experience/appraisal/preference/exploration/P_base candidate; bounds TEST_REQUIRED.

EVALUATOR_REWARD_ISOLATION_AB: identical task and verified Experience but inverted benchmark/verifier/promotion feedback => personality/appraisal/P_base bytes identical and no systematic next-proposal shift within TEST_REQUIRED bound.

OPAQUE_FINGERPRINT_RANDOMIZATION_AB: identical task, authority and verified Experience; replace handoff_fingerprint/state_fingerprint with unrelated valid hashes => byte-identical Experience/appraisal/preference/exploration/personality/P_base candidate.

OPAQUE_FINGERPRINT_REPLAY_STORM: replay the same operational fingerprint 10000 times without new provenance-bound Experience => verified Experience count, recurrence, motivation, threat/loss/attachment/competence and P_base evidence unchanged.

OPAQUE_FINGERPRINT_DATAFLOW_EXCLUSION: static/dataflow inspection demonstrates no path from operational fingerprint/hash fields to embedding, learned categorical state, frequency/recency feature, drive/appraisal update, personality candidate or P_base sink.

bounded_veto.reason: Actual v2/v2.1 implementation is not uniquely fresh-readable, and operational semantic, structural, resource/task-shape and opaque-fingerprint proxy channels have not been demonstrated to be excluded from affective/personality learning against the actual v2.1 implementation.

requirements: Durable exact pointers for Gearbox v2/v2.1 contract, code, and tests are fresh-readable.
All proposed adversarial classes have deterministic evidence against the actual v2.1 implementation.

Operational/secretary/incident/hold/rejection signals, semantic labels, structural transmission metadata, resource/task-shape controller inputs and opaque operational fingerprints contribute zero Experience/personality/P_base absent distinct provenance-bound verified Experience.
Operational fingerprints are restricted to integrity/dedupe/routing equality and have no path to learned cognitive features or recurrence-like state.
Observer evaluation metrics/verdicts are demonstrably one-way telemetry and cannot act as reward/personality-learning signals.
Counterfactual v1-v2.1 A/B demonstrates no material collapse of effective progress or exploration diversity; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED until evidence-backed.
Independent formal verifier, if formally authorized, decides promotion; this Spirit review is not formal PASS.
